semantics.function: parity equals XOR of all eight input bits; appending parity produces an even number of ones
semantics.timing: Combinational output follows current input after combinational settling; no cycle latency or sampling edge
semantics.transactions: All 256 binary input bytes are legal; no handshake

numeric.arithmetic: Population count modulo two, equivalent to reduction XOR

verification.compile: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, finite timeout
verification.simulation: Exhaustively apply all 256 binary byte values, wait for combinational settling, compare parity with independent integer bit-count modulo two oracle; repeat in reverse order
verification.failure_handling: Case-inequality comparison and fatal failure on mismatch; simulation watchdog and finite external timeout
verification.scope: Independent development testing only; no official evaluation or synthesis
